content.intro: Learn method_missing and respond_to_missing? through a visual model, a minimal Ruby example, and a practical check.
content.why_it_matters: Understanding method_missing and respond_to_missing? helps you write code that is easier to explain, test, and maintain. It also helps separate Ruby language guarantees from runtime assumptions, dependency behavior, and application-specific rules.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: method_missing and respond_to_missing? helps you reason about intercepting missing method calls. In Ruby, prefer a small example whose inputs and expected result are easy to explain. This lesson connects the syllabus topic to practical code and highlights where assumptions or edge cases matter.

content_blocks.title: How to think about it
content_blocks.text: Begin by identifying the key rule: Intercepting missing method calls. Then connect it to Keeping introspection consistent. The remaining syllabus points—Delegation and dynamic interfaces, Avoiding overly magical APIs—are useful checks before applying this in a larger project.
